description:
Reassignment local search only:
- Incoming Ordering: Sort newly assigned unscheduled tasks by descending reward, then smaller task ID.
- Segment Search: For each consecutive 3-observation segment, try both cyclic reorderings, placing incoming tasks first; if broken edges exist, only try segments containing an endpoint.
- Acceptance & Termination: Return null immediately when both incoming tasks and broken edges are absent; otherwise return the highest-profit feasible issued trial, or null if none is found within the evaluation limit.
